title: XPLAT-010 estimate-spec-size Runner Operation
description: Contract for the restored estimate-spec-size read-only runner helper (FR-025 / US7). Restores the scoping estimator whose Bash predecessor (speckit-pro/skills/speckit-autopilot/scripts/estimate-spec-size.sh) was deleted by XPLAT-009 without a Python port. Callers: the grill-me and speckit-prd skills. Golden fixtures already exist at tests/speckit-pro/layer4-scripts/fixtures/estimate-spec-size/.

request.description: Runner request envelope. helper_id/operation/mode fixed; inputs carry the size signals the grill-me and speckit-prd skills send (mirroring the deleted bash's --user-stories/--files/--frs flags). Non-numeric or negative signals are coerced leniently rather than rejected (golden fixture bad-input: abc/-5/3.5 -> estimated_loc 0, status ok).

result.description: The data.* payload returned to the caller.

estimated_loc.description: Projected reviewable LOC computed from the size signals (golden: --files 11 -> 440; --files 20 -> 800; --user-stories 2 --files 3 --frs 4 -> 230).

suggested_slices.description: Recommended PR-slice count (golden: 1 under the warn ceiling, 2 at/over it).

status.description: warn once the estimate crosses the scoping ceiling (golden: 440 and 800 -> warn), otherwise ok.
